messages:
alex: Holding the unpin for runtime v3.2 — EU canary shows a subtle but consistent tail-latency drift on long-seq quantized models. Not rolling forward until we nail a mitigation.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary (canary-eu):
```
service: runtime-v3.2-canary
model: llama3q-quant-v2
window: 2025-07-15T10:00Z - 10:12Z
metrics: p95 +8%, p99 +12% (longseq workload)
errors: none
```

maria: @alex can you paste the exact queries that spike? long-seq vs typical chat?

liz: The regression correlates with sequences > 1024 tokens. Short chats look fine. Repro in perf-test-2 using `longseq-A` prompt set.

sre-oncall: Does the fallback to v3.1 trigger automatically for failing tails, or do we need a reroute? Capacity in eu-west-1 is tight.

ops-qa: If we unpin now we risk client incompat for a small subset; suggested plan: staged reroute + enable kvcache-compat fallback. Freeze change window for 30m while we validate.

alex: Proposed mitigation (minimal blast radius):
- add region-level route: `route.europe` -> prefer runtime-v3.1 for model llama3q-quant-v2 when seq_len > 1024
- enable kvcache-fallback for in-flight sessions
- keep runtime v3.2 pinned everywhere else

Config snippet:
```json
{"routing": {"rules": [{"region": "eu-west-1", "model": "llama3q-quant-v2", "condition": "seq_len>1024", "target": "runtime-v3.1"}]}}
```

maria: That sounds good. Can we do the route change via `deployctl route apply --staged` so we can rollback quickly?

alex: Yes — steps: 1) `deployctl route apply --staged eu-longseq-mitigation` 2) smoke-run perf-test-2 3) promote if p99 stabilizes < +5% 

deploy-bot: @alex started staged route apply (eu-longseq-mitigation) — job 68192
```
> apply started: 1749991280
> target: route-change (staged)
> status: in-progress
```

sre-oncall: Monitoring live: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/perf/canary-eu?panel=latency (watching p95/p99) :eyes:

ops-qa: Running perf-test-2 now against staged routes. ETA ~3m.

liz: Initial run: p95 unchanged, p99 dropped from +12% to +3% for longseq set. Looks promising.

maria: Great. If metrics hold for next 15m, we promote and document the change in release notes.

alex: Promote now? deployctl route promote eu-longseq-mitigation -> executing.

deploy-bot: promotion complete. job 68192 -> success.

alex: Rolling notes for release team: applied targeted reroute for longseq in EU to avoid widespread unpin. Will include rationale and config snippet in the release notes.

sre-oncall: Observability: no error rate increase, CPU/GPU utilization stable. Closing incident window in 30m unless something pops.

ops-qa: QA signoff: longseq smoke and regression suite passed. Recommend documenting fallback policy and adding longseq tests to preflight for future unpins.

maria: Agree — add `longseq-A` to preflight and flag in the rollout checklist.

alex: TLDR: we deferred full unpin, applied region+condition routing to runtime-v3.1 for seq_len>1024 in EU, promoted after validation. No rollback required. Will add to release notes and follow up with a post-change perf audit. :white_check_mark:
